rules.when: The task depends on fresh news, current events, live public facts, or recent market and product changes.
rules.why: Use the Grok TUI for live web context. grok models lists grok-4.7 as the default, with grok-4.6, grok-4.5, and grok-4.7-build-fast also available. Do not treat a Pi xAI model as a substitute unless the captain says Pi has the needed live source.

rules.when: The task is report-only reconnaissance, file gathering, a narrow lookup, or a trivial mechanical edit such as a rote rename, formatting sweep, or targeted typo fix.
rules.why: Cheap current profiles only. Claude haiku is the fast alias. Codex catalog calls gpt-6-luna fast and affordable. Keep low effort. Do not spend Astra, Opus, or Fable here.

rules.when: The task is ordinary implementation, a bounded bug fix, tests, or everyday coding with a clear path.
rules.why: Workhorse class. Codex catalog calls gpt-6-sol the coding workhorse. Claude sonnet is the current daily-coding alias and launches permissionless. Pi xAI grok-4.7 matches the current xAI default. Resolve the array by quota, not by list order.

rules.when: The task is a large or ambiguous multi-file change, a risky refactor, or work that must hold many moving parts together.
rules.why: Strong coding class, not the frontier class. Claude opus is the current complex-reasoning alias. Do not pick Fable here: an unattended Claude pane can stall on its usage-credit consent prompt.

rules.when: The task is the hardest available work: root-cause investigation, architecture, ambiguous design, or a long session that has already failed on a workhorse profile.
rules.why: Frontier class. Codex catalog calls gpt-6-astra frontier intelligence for the most demanding work. Do not use max or ultra unless the captain explicitly asks. Do not auto-select Claude fable.
